Overall a good app. TL,DR This is a good app, does what it says on the tin.

The app has a very simple minimalist design, incredibly easy to use, and looks relatively good.

However, the reset button is only pressed in the event something negative occurs, ‘punishing’ yourself every time you don't do what you are required to.

This is in contrast to a different system (not used by this app) in which you press a button every time you have done something correctly, ‘rewarding’ yourself for doing what you are meant to. In this case the button pressing gives you instant gratification.

People differ for what motivates them more (punishment or reward), but generally reward is a better motivator. Though a reward system (like I’ve outlined) helps to further a dependance on instant gratification. 

(I am no physiologist or expert)

Simple. Easy. Encouraging. While the thing I was trying to quit wouldn’t be seen as a problem by many, it was something I wanted to get away from, Since was all I needed, nothing to fancy, and that’s a good thing, let me enter dates, gave me little encouraging notes every week, and helped me see my progress, which was often very encouraging. It’s been with me this whole time, and it’s never let me down.
